# PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013

## This Practice Direction supplements CPR Part 57

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > This Practice Direction supplements CPR Part 57] Contents of this practice direction

## Procedure for claims – Rule 57.19

## Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] 1.1 The claim form for a claim for a declaration of presumed death must include or be accompanied by the following (where known)—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (1) Information about the claimant

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (a) the claimant’s name and address;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (b) the relationship of the claimant to the missing person; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (c) if the claimant is not the missing person’s spouse, civil partner, parent, child or sibling, details of the claimant’s interest in the determination of the application;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (2) Information about the missing person

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (a) the missing person’s name and surname, and any other names by which the missing person is or has formerly been known;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (b) the missing person’s gender;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (c) the missing person’s maiden surname (if any);

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (d) the missing person’s date and place of birth;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (e) the occupation of the missing person;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (f) the occupation, name and surname of —

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (i) the missing person’s spouse or civil partner (or late spouse or civil partner if the marriage or civil partnership ended on death);

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (ii) where the missing person was under 16 years of age, the missing person’s parents;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (g) the missing person’s National Insurance number;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (h) the date on which missing person is thought to have died, or on which the missing person was last known have been alive;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (i) on which of the grounds in section 1(4) of the 2013 Act the court is considered to have jurisdiction to entertain the claim;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (j) the usual or last known address of the missing person; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (k) the name and address of the spouse or civil partner, parents, children or siblings of the missing person (if any, and if not the claimant);

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (3) Information about steps taken to trace the missing person

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (a) details of any enquiries made or other steps taken to trace the missing person or confirm when the missing person was last known to be alive; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (b) details of the results of such enquiries or other steps;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (4) Information about the missing person’s property

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (a) an estimate of the total value of the assets of the missing person;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (b) details of property owned by the missing person; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (c) details of the interest of any other person in the missing person’s property which it is sought to have determined by the court; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (5) Information about advertisement and recipients of notice of the claim

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (a) details of the newspaper in which the claimant proposes to advertise the claim; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for declaration of presumed death – claim form] (b) details of the persons to whom the claimant is giving notice of the claim and, where notice is being given to a person under rule 57.20(1)(f), the nature of that person’s interest in the claim.

## Claim for variation order

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] 1.2 The claim form for a variation order must include or be accompanied by the following (where known)—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (1) Information about the claimant

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (a) the claimant’s name and address;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (b) the relationship of the claimant to the missing person; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (c) details of the claimant’s interest in the determination of the application;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (2) Information about previous claim and missing person’s property

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (a) details of the declaration of presumed death or (as the case may be) previous variation order which it is sought to have varied or revoked;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (b) details of the circumstances which are claimed to justify a variation order, and evidence of the enquiries made and other steps taken to verify them and their outcomes; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (c) details of any interest in property acquired as a result of the declaration of presumed death or (as the case may be) previous variation order which it is sought to have varied or revoked; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (3) Information about advertisement and recipients of notice of the claim

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (a) details of the newspaper in which the claimant proposes to advertise the claim; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Claim for variation order] (b) details of the persons to whom the claimant is giving notice of the claim and, where notice is being given to a person under rule 57.20(2)(g), the nature of that person’s interest in the claim.

## Issue of claim form without serving notice on any person

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Issue of claim form without serving notice on any person] 1.3 For the purposes of rule 8.2A as modified by rule 57.19, an application for permission to issue a claim form, whether the claim is for a declaration or presumed death or for a variation order, may be made only where the claimant believes there to be no person within paragraph (1)(a) to (f) or paragraph (2)(a) to (g) of rule 57.20. The application must explain why the claimant believes that there is no such person.

## Case management – first directions hearing

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Case management – first directions hearing] 1.4 A claim (whether for a declaration of presumed death or for a variation order) must be listed for case management directions either—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Case management – first directions hearing] (a) more than 28 days (but where practicable no more than 56 days) after issue; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Case management – first directions hearing] (b) where the claim form has been served outside the jurisdiction, more than 7 days (but where practicable no more than 35 days) after the period for filing provided for by rule 57.19(7), to allow for time for those served with notice of the claim or who respond to the advertisement of the claim to file notice of intention to intervene or an application for permission to intervene as the case may be.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Case management – first directions hearing] 1.5 The court must notify all those who have filed notice of intention to intervene or an application for permission to intervene of the date of the directions hearing.

## Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] 2.1 The advertisement of the claim required by section 9(2) of the 2013 Act and rule 57.21(1)(a) must be in the form set out below, or contain the equivalent information about the claim and the possibility of applying, and where and by when to apply, to the Court—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUSTICE [CHANCERY] [FAMILY] DIVISION

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] Case Number ……

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] IN THE MATTER OF AN APPLICATION FOR A DECLARATION OF THE PRESUMED DEATH OF (INSERT NAME)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] A claim has been issued in the High Court of Justice, for a [declaration] [variation of a declaration] that (insert name), whose last known address was (insert address) is presumed to be dead. Any person having an interest may apply to the Court to intervene in the matter.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] If you wish to apply to the Court, you should do so at [Court address] as soon as possible, and if possible within 21 days of the date of this notice. Delay may harm your prospects of being able to intervene.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] [If the claimant is legally represented]

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] (Name)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] Claimant’s Legal Representative

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] (Address)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] [If the claimant is not legally represented]

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Advertisement of claim – Rule 57.21] (Claimant’s address for service)

## Interveners – Rule 57.22

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Interveners – Rule 57.22] 3.1 The Attorney General, or a person who is entitled to intervene in the proceedings by virtue of section 11(1) (the missing person’s spouse, civil partner, parent, child or sibling) should notify the intention to intervene as early as possible by filing, and serving on the claimant, notice in writing, specifying—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Interveners – Rule 57.22] (a) the intervener’s name and address;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Interveners – Rule 57.22] (b) the intervener’s relationship to the missing person (where the intervener is not the Attorney General);

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Interveners – Rule 57.22] (c) the reasons for intervening; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Interveners – Rule 57.22] (d) particulars of any determination or order sought under section 11(4)(b) or (c) of the 2013 Act.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Interveners – Rule 57.22] 3.2 An application under rule 57.22(2) for permission to intervene must be served on the claimant and must specify—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Interveners – Rule 57.22] (a) the applicant’s relationship to the missing person or other interest in the proceedings;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Interveners – Rule 57.22] (b) the reasons for seeking to intervene; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 57B – PROCEEDINGS UNDER THE PRESUMPTION OF DEATH ACT 2013 > Interveners – Rule 57.22] (c) particulars of any determination or order sought under section 11(4)(b) or (c) of the 2013 Act.
